Beginners Course - December, 6 sessions

This course is designed for complete beginners who are new to Capoeira or new to the London School of Capoeira. During the course, you’ll learn the basic movements and techniques of Capoeira while improving your fitness, coordination, and confidence. By the end of the course, you’ll be ready to progress to more advanced classes.

After completing the beginner course, you’ll be eligible to join our regular class

Course Details:

  • When: It starts from the beginning of each month and it normally runs for 4 weeks, 1 hour sessions. Tuesday and Thursday 7-8pm

    Next Course: December 1st, 3rd, 8th, 10th, 15th and 17th, 6 sessions (due to the holidays)

  • Where: London School of Capoeira, unit 1-2 Leeds Place, London N4 3RF

  • Clothing: Please wear comfortable tracksuit trousers and a T-shirt during this course. Shorts are not permitted. Once the course has been completed and you have joined the school, the LSCH uniform will be required.
